source.time_scope: Historical snapshot; no per-listing timestamp, not current market data

clustering.method: NumPy KMeans++ / Lloyd, 10 starts, 150 iterations maximum
clustering.purpose: exploratory segmentation; no ground truth, prediction, investment recommendation or market validation

sql_benchmark.query:
SELECT row_id, area_m2, sale_price_vnd, price_per_m2_vnd
FROM listings
WHERE province_id = ? AND type_id = ?
  AND price_per_m2_vnd BETWEEN ? AND ?
ORDER BY price_per_m2_vnd, row_id LIMIT 100

plan: USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY
SEARCH listings USING INDEX idx_listings_search (province_id=? AND type_id=? AND price_per_m2_vnd>? AND price_per_m2_vnd<?)

sql_benchmark.protocol: One real source snapshot. Same connection, SQL and parameters; before/after composite index, 10 warmups + 51 timings. Small warm-cache benchmark, not a production speedup claim.

policies: No imputation of price or area; recover explicit area from top-level price only.
Deduplicate only when all five normalized core fields match; preserve canonical raw row id.
Quarantine parsed total price below 10m VND for manual review; do not correct presumed units.
IQR outliers flagged and retained in main analysis; group fallback requires n>=30.
Type inferred from title, sale status partly assumed; sensitivity shows explicit sale titles.
Ignore suspicious detail fields; no bedroom/legal/coordinates/date inference.
Area dot thousands convention flagged; sensitivity excludes affected rows.
Province requires explicit match to historical 2021 allowlist or known alias; unrecognized locations become Chưa xác định, never inferred from streets.
CSV clean output omits titles, description, contacts and exact street addresses.
limitations: Convenience sample, listing duplicates may remain, no representative market inference.
Historical locality names from original snapshot; no conversion to 2026 administrative boundaries.
Asking prices may be erroneous, installments or per-area prices entered as totals; automatic flags cannot resolve all.
Property type heuristics require human audit; no transaction-level identifiers or dates.
Bootstrap intervals assume independent ads conditionally on this sample; repeated agents/dependence can understate uncertainty.
Correlation is descriptive; derived price-per-area variables cause mathematical coupling.
KMeans has no external validation and is an optional teaching extension.
